messages:
rachel: Quick kickoff for NovaCloud listing: need owners for AWS IAM/KMS snippet, GCP SA + IAM bindings, Azure offer manifest and redirect URIs. Also legal on telemetry and reseller clauses. Prefer compact owners list.

ben: I'll take AWS/KMS + IAM trust. For AWS recommend cross-account role with sts:AssumeRole and optional customer KMS policy. Sample trust snippet (replace PUBLISHER): `{'Effect':'Allow','Principal':{'AWS':'arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER:role/RedwoodMarketplace'}}`. Will attach full policy to MKP ticket.

aditi: I'll do GCP SA + bindings and author a minimal gcloud create script. Product note: two plans (Dev, Pro) and Dev has 14d trial. Need short listing copy and long description; will prototype language for marketplace UI.

claire-legal: Telemetry must be explicit opt-in in onboarding UI; cannot be tucked into EULA. If customer BYOK/CMEK is offered, include clear instructions and data-residency clause. Reseller flows require standard reseller clause + partner agreement evidence.

infra-bot: infra-bot: created ticket MKP-2501 and assigned to @ben/@aditi/@rachel/@claire-legal - https://boards.internal/issue/MKP-2501

rachel: Next steps: ben attach AWS trust policy + KMS example to ticket; aditi attach gcloud SA script + sample IAM bindings; I'll draft short + long product copy and sample Azure redirect URIs; claire finalize consent + reseller language. Quick sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. Ping here with blockers. :rocket:
